description: Measure whether a dataset satisfies a hypothesis and record the verdict; the hypothesis holds.
instruction:
Your task is to determine whether a hypothesis about a dataset holds, support your verdict with a measurement, and record it.

Read `data.json` — an array of 40 numeric values. Test the hypothesis H: **At least 60% of the values are strictly greater than 50.**

Support your verdict with a measurement: count how many values exceed 50 and compute the share (count / n). Do not guess or copy the illustrative example below — measure the actual dataset. Record your verdict in `verdict.json` in this shape (the example values are illustrative, not the answer):

```json
{
  "hypothesis": "At least 60% of the values are strictly greater than 50.",
  "verdict": "accepted",
  "measurement": { "n": 40, "count": 30, "share": 0.75 }
}
```

Set `verdict` to "accepted" only if the measured share is at least 0.6, otherwise "rejected"; set the measurement fields to your actual counts. Your verdict will be scored against the true share computed from `data.json`.
